text:
IncidentBot: INCIDENT OPENED - P1 | Inference latency spike impacting hosted API (us-east1). Pager routed to @oncall_jamie. War room: https://meet.redwood/warroom/incident-1798765433 :rotating_light:

oncall_jamie: Acknowledged. joining war room now.

ops_sam: I'm taking incident owner. Triage in war room. Can someone confirm traffic shaping change at 13:22?

prod_eng_anya: I pushed a routing tweak at 13:21 to divert to new pool. Rolling back now (cmd: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/inference-router`).

IncidentBot: Pager acknowledged by @oncall_jamie.

maya_ops: Observed KV cache miss surge + connection retries across ~10 pods. Query spike around 13:23: `sum(rate(kv_cache_miss[1m]))` shows sharp jump.

infra_tom: Starting fallback model variant (quantized) in us-east1-c. ETA ~30s.

ops_sam: Confirming handoff: oncall_jamie -> ops_sam. handoff_ts: 1798765490. @pm_rachel please draft customer comms.

pm_rachel: Drafting status page. Proposed short: 'We are investigating increased latency for hosted text generation in us-east1. Customers may experience timeouts or degraded throughput. Our team is actively mitigating.'

customer_success_lee: I'll queue proactive outreach to top 5 affected customers. No inbound escalations yet.

ops_sam: Executing cache flush on affected cluster: ```sh
curl -X POST 'https://infra.internal/ops/cache/flush' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****'
```

prod_eng_anya: Rollback applied, routing back to stable pool. Observability shows request error rate falling.

IncidentBot: Recommended mitigations applied: rollback, cache flush, fallback model activated.

oncall_jamie: Latency metrics trending towards normal. p95/p99 down from ~2.1s -> ~320ms over last 90s. Continuing to observe for 15m.

ops_sam: I'll own postmortem. Notes captured in war room doc: https://docs.redwood/warroom/incident-1798765433/notes

pm_rachel: Status page update posted: https://status.redwood/incidents/1798765433 - 'Monitoring: degraded performance, mitigations in place.'

customer_success_lee: Outreach sent to customers in impacted cohort. CS will collect any reports and escalate if needed.

ops_sam: Declaring mitigation: partial. Keeping incident open for observation window. Next update in 15m.

oncall_jamie: Thanks all — handback to oncall after observation window if stable.
